Attached: 1 video

Apple's engineering listings describe work on general purpose AI agents capable of browsing the web, using applications, executing commands, and writing code.

The project remains in development, with no announced consumer release date.

@leo@twit.social, @ihnatko@twit.social, @jsnell@zepplin.flights & @film_girl examine whether Apple's platform integration and privacy controls could distinguish its approach from competing agents.

#Apple #AgenticAI
